The procurement directly advances U.S. economic interests and supports domestic reindustrialization by building foreign public and institutional alignment with U.S. commercial standards. The Government intends to contract this training for III MEF Force Reconnaissance Company to provide its personnel with sustainment, refinement, and enhancement of their existing Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC) and Advanced Combat Tactical Trauma Care (AMT) skill sets. The trauma scenarios will be conducted using Live Patient Models (LMP) presenting the operator with multiple different types of patients like hemorrhagic hypovolemia, compromised airway, and severe traumatic brain injury. The scope of treatments that will be trained are from basic hemorrhage control up to advanced airway and thoracic procedures such

hage control up to advanced airway and thoracic procedures such as surgical airway and chest thoracotomy.
